question: Can a small causal reading gate exploit one self-generated calculation on fresh full continuations without losing the unchanged raw reference?
identity: A proposed new mechanism; V30 stays failed and its reward branch stays closed. Not a fixed-mixture sweep or a new pretraining claim.

prediction.reference: Actual unchanged B0, frozen, original native prefix plus previous continuation tokens only. No Calculation wrapper in this branch.
prediction.assisted: Chronological first V29 computation checkpoint, frozen. One greedy prefix-only calculation per document, cap128 including sampled stop. Preserve all attempts and partial notes.
prediction.equation: p_final,t=(1-g_t)*p_B0,t+g_t*p_assisted,t. Normalize both over the original full model output width, including its original padded rows. Apply no new reader vocabulary mask; writer support masks remain a separate frozen policy.
prediction.gate: One logistic linear head with a fixed zero region: s_t=sigmoid(b+w^T f_t), g_t=max(0,(s_t-tau)/(1-tau)), tau=.01. Same rule in learning and prediction; no straight-through estimator or threshold search. No backbone, writer, reader or tokenizer updates.

features.hidden_states: Detached, final-normalized B0 and assisted hidden states at context_length+t-1 for zero-based target t. That row predicts target[t]; target[t] itself and later tokens cannot affect the row. The common source history is the prefix and preceding continuation; only the assisted branch also sees the note.
metadata: entropy of each current predictive distribution
features.normalization: RMS-normalize each detached hidden vector separately using only that vector and epsilon1e-6. Divide entropies by log(full_model_output_width); action count and position are divided by128 and16. No DEV-fitted statistics.

prediction.off_switch: CPU implementation returns original raw prediction object for disabled/all-closed paths and exact raw row values in mixed batches. It can skip assisted work when called disabled with no assisted input. Actual released-model/native/pipeline qualification remains outstanding.
prediction.important_limit: The specified raw branches are exact identities; active positive-gate prediction can still harm. No universal active retention bound is claimed. Choosing zero after a note has been computed does not recover its generation cost.

protocol.all_documents: Exactly512 original native prefix tokens and the next16 original tokens, on both calculation and ordinary panels. Do not retokenize source splices or crop the raw reference.
protocol.writer_input: The same prefix plus the native encoding of newline Calculation colon newline, for EVERY document. No source-kind indicator, curator expression, target or correctness input. One deterministic greedy note, existing stop/support policy, cap128 including stop.
protocol.assisted_context: Reuse train.real_trace_contexts.reader_context: prefix + supplied opening + intact generated native content (excluding only its sampled stop) + the same full Answer newline closure. Score original target16 at natural causal positions.
protocol.invalid_notes: Keep all notes, including empty, unsupported, wrong and capped notes. Unsupported arithmetic is not an execution error or reason to fall back. A cap retains the entire partial note and receives the same forced closure; log that intervention.
protocol.ordinary_protocol: Run that SAME writer and reader protocol on ordinary prefixes, without requiring a computable expression or silently substituting an empty note. The active ordinary suffix16 endpoint therefore measures the actual proposed system.
protocol.reference_context: For target index t, prefix+target[:t] only; the off switch returns the existing B0 predictive object directly and skips writer and assisted reader.
protocol.errors: Any model/feature/scoring execution error makes completeness fail; never silently discard the source or count a convenient fallback as a successful ordinary attempt.

learning_signal.phase: Only supervised gate learning after feature/source qualification; not currently released.
learning_signal.initialization: tau=.01, w=0, b=log(.0199/.9801), so s=.0199 and initial g=.01, strictly inside the learning region. Initial probability-mixture regret is at most -log(.99) per token. No such universal bound holds after learning.
learning_signal.objective: Mean full16 negative log likelihood per document. The current gold token enters ONLY the loss through detached B0/assisted target log-probabilities; never gate.forward(features).
learning_signal.gradient: For s>tau, dg/db=s*(1-s)/(1-tau) and dL/db=-(dg/db)*(p_assisted(y)-p_B0(y))/p_final(y); for s<=tau the specified derivative is0. Current target probabilities enter only this loss. A frozen writer needs no policy reward to train the head.
learning_signal.training_distribution: Actual greedy notes from the fixed writer, including wrong/unsupported/capped notes. No hindsight acceptance filter, supplied-perfect-only reader distribution or best-of-G note selection.
learning_signal.why_no_zero_signal_bootstrap_claim: The writer/reader already exist and remain frozen. This tests learning how to use their outputs,not autonomous discovery. Writer RL remains outside scope.

proposed_head_recipe.status: Concrete fixed proposal. Only tiny synthetic CPU optimization fixtures have run; no actual cached-model experiment head or optimizer has been fitted.
proposed_head_recipe.optimizer: AdamW on head weights/bias only, FP64 CPU loss and parameters, lr0.01, betas(0.9,0.999), epsilon1e-8, weight_decay0.0001 on weights and0 on bias, global gradient clip1.
proposed_head_recipe.exposures: 10 complete passes over5120 TRAIN documents, batch64 documents,800 updates, constant LR. Shuffle full documents with two fixed optimization-order seeds2026102131/2026102132. No repeated token treated as an independent item.
proposed_head_recipe.loss: Average16 token CEs within each document, then average documents. For s>tau use logaddexp(log(1-g)+lp_B0,log(g)+lp_assisted), evaluating log(1-g) with logsigmoid(-u)-log(1-tau) and log(g) with stable log-difference arithmetic. For s<=tau return lp_B0 directly with zero head gradient. Avoid log(0), saturated-probability arithmetic and invalid inactive-branch gradients. B0/assisted distributions and features are detached.
proposed_head_recipe.checkpoint: Terminal800 heads are primary. Save training losses/head states; no DEV-based early stopping, coefficient search or alternate head architecture.
proposed_head_recipe.frozen_cost: Repeated head passes reuse frozen feature caches, not new backbone/writer passes. Report their extra supervision and work separately.

learning_signal.zero_region_risk: The head receives no local gradient on a closed token and may stall at raw prediction. Positive interior initialization starts learning; it does not guarantee continued learning. Do not silently change the threshold or add exploration to rescue a failed run.

instrumentation.each_training_update: Log document CE, fraction with exactly zero gate, positive-gate quantiles, preclip CE-gradient norm, optimizer-step norm and nonfinite counts. Keep data-gradient effects distinguishable from weight decay and optimizer momentum.
instrumentation.fixed_TRAIN_probe: Every80 updates and at terminal, evaluate the same first256 TRAIN documents in a prespecified hash order from cached features only. Report closures by source stratum and continuation position; strata are reporting labels, never gate inputs.
instrumentation.opportunity_diagnostic: On that fixed probe, report closed gates where the assisted gold-token probability exceeds B0 and where it does not. These target-dependent labels diagnose training only and never enter gate.forward.
instrumentation.interpretation: Many closed gates plus negligible data gradients may expose parameterization/optimization stalling. Do not infer that the frozen predictors lack complementary information, or change threshold/initialization/schedule within the run. A failed run remains failed.

controls: Unchanged B0 raw; primary absolute predictive reference.

A single global probability-mixture coefficient minimized on TRAIN only, including both endpoints. Solve its one-dimensional convex likelihood objective; do not select from a DEV grid. No causal features or gate degrees of freedom.

A matched causal head combining B0 with the SAME T checkpoint in raw mode, with no Calculation wrapper or generated note. Same head size, optimizer, source documents, order and exposures; replace note count/cap metadata with zero. This tests ordinary ensembling.

On a fresh, preselected subset, empty, intact unrelated and deterministic corrupted-note interventions. Recompute causal assisted features for the deployed intervention. Optionally holding original gate weights per position fixed is a separately labelled mediation diagnostic, never a new deployed gate.
These controls do not match all extra autoregressive processing. Beating them supports this predictive recipe, not a universal advantage of semantic traces over every extra-compute alternative.
Competitive conventional CoT and exact arithmetic interpreter remain necessary before a practical efficiency claim. Such a claim is outside this gate-only proposal.

Secondary: sixteen TRAIN-optimal probability-mixture weights, one per known continuation position, without hidden/context inputs. This controls a simple number-first/prose-later schedule. Primary eight conjunctive requirements/power remain unchanged; a context-adaptation interpretation also needs an advantage over this control.

fresh_data_before_learning.TRAIN_composition: 2560 computable arithmetic anchors and2560 ordinary FineMath prefixes. All prefixes512 tokens; one anchor per unique source page; no repetition to meet the quota. This is a deliberately enriched laboratory, not the natural frequency of arithmetic in text.
fresh_data_before_learning.separation: Unique source pages/content/documents; exact ordered-expression separation for arithmetic. Exclude all prior retained training/evaluation/proposal documents. No official TEST or pretraining-novelty claim.
fresh_data_before_learning.causal_contract: Each model sees prefix and already-observed continuation only. Before the gate head is learned, feature extraction must pass a current/future-token perturbation test and independent prefix-only forwards.
fresh_data_before_learning.feature_cache: Inputs/causal features and supervised targets are separate typed artifacts. No gold LP or label is stored inside the gate-input array.
fresh_data_before_learning.readiness: CPU-only fixed12-shard source preparation is active under sourcecb3a47b. Downloads and filtering complete; exact arithmetic/native cohorts still unresolved. No released-model feature extraction or experiment-head learning.
fresh_data_before_learning.power: Fixed4096 calculation+4096 ordinary DEV documents from the prospective feasibility plan, before new source outcomes. Normal planning alternative gives joint lower.917 at SD4/base gain.5/control gains.25/ordinary gain0; smaller effects/heavier tails remain sensitivity limits. No outcome-dependent expansion.

sample_size_addendum.reason: The provisional1024 is inadequate under SD4 and control gain.25. N4096 per panel has normal-approximation joint passage lower bound.917 under the stated planning alternative, not a guarantee for unknown/heavy-tailed effects.
sample_size_addendum.no_outcome_adaptation: No later expansion, weakened exclusion or smaller cohort after outcomes.

prospective_result_needed.primary: On fresh calculation DEV, actual learned-gate/greedy-note full16 gain over B0 has mean>=.25nats and positive paired95 lower bound.
prospective_result_needed.content_and_selection: Gain over both the TRAIN-fitted global mixture and non-thought ensemble must have positive paired95 lower bounds. Otherwise no content-specific selective-use claim.
prospective_result_needed.ordinary_guard: On fresh ordinary DEV, the ACTIVE same protocol has final16 per-token NLL regression versus B0 with upper95<=.03. Off-mode identity alone cannot satisfy this guard.
prospective_result_needed.seed_limit: Two gate optimization orders with one frozen backbone do not establish training-model robustness.
prospective_result_needed.terminal_primary: Freeze optimizer/update count and use terminal heads. No dev checkpoint/prompt/cap selection or threshold revision.
prospective_result_needed.all_attempts: Retain all source documents, generated actions, errors/caps/unsupported counts and all absolute scores. Base failures invalidate completeness; no silent omission.
prospective_result_needed.costs: Count writer actions, reader forwards, head work, source exposure and supervised tokens separately. Teacher-forced scoring latency is not an autoregressive serving benchmark. Full free-running generation/latency needs its own qualification before any deployment-efficiency claim.
prospective_result_needed.failure: If the gate collapses to raw, fails the fresh full16/control/ordinary tests, or only matches an ensemble,close that proposal without writer RL or scale escalation.
prospective_result_needed.pass: A supervised selective-reading mechanism only. It releases neither RL nor CPT. Any subsequent writer optimization needs a separate fixed-reader reward/variation study under the NEW interface.
prospective_result_needed.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over unique source documents, resampling related variants as one family if introduced. Proposed5000 draws, seed2026102133; report each optimization order separately. All primary/guard contrasts are conjunctive; no selective use of whichever order passes.
prospective_result_needed.retention_scope: This is the final16-token FineMath prediction window, not full-window or broad-language retention. Report token/component and tail costs without replacing the declared full16 primary.
prospective_result_needed.content_claim: Superiority over the raw ensemble and constant blend alone is not proof of faithful semantic reasoning. Empty/donor/corrupt interventions are supporting diagnostics, and all altered-context distributions must be reported.

corpus_reporting.units: Report both stratum gains as nats per16. Ordinary NLL cost c per token corresponds to continuation gain -16*c.
corpus_reporting.formula: Delta(q)=q*Delta_calculation+(1-q)*Delta_ordinary, for a fixed prevalence q of calculation-boundary windows under a specified source-window sampling policy.
corpus_reporting.threshold_counterexample: Hypothetical gains +.25 calculation and -.48 ordinary satisfy the numerical point/tolerance boundary yet break even only at q=.48/(.25+.48)=.657534. This is algebra, not a measured corpus result or a statistical guarantee from a point threshold.
corpus_reporting.required_report: Report the full prevalence tradeoff and break-even prevalence when defined. At prespecified q values, obtain intervals by independent document/family resampling within each stratum. Never choose q to claim a success.
corpus_reporting.prevalence_status: No representative natural-source q has been measured. A fraction of documents mentioning arithmetic is not the prevalence of the exact calculation-boundary windows. Without representative sampling, report hypothetical mixtures only.
corpus_reporting.claim_boundary: Passing the mechanism/retention criteria cannot be called an overall natural-corpus LM gain; keep those criteria and that broader claim separate.

prospective_result_needed.cost_plan: validation/causal_reader_cost_plan_20261021.json;8reservedchip-hour proposed hard total includingqualification,3roles on all13312science documents plus1024fixed secondary contexts; old proxy7.780. Actual source/runtime feasibility and whole-question review remain required. No model execution released.

prior_proposal_resolution.pointwise_cap_variant: The earlier universal per-token .03-regret cap remains rejected for the fixed saved candidates: its hindsight upper bound averages .137nats per16 on the inspected V30 panel.
prior_proposal_resolution.distinction: The revised draft keeps exact off-mode identity but relies on prospective empirical active-mode retention. It does not claim that fallback availability guarantees a good learned selector.
prior_proposal_resolution.old_evidence: No fixed-mixture policy sweep or new model result is reported; the original V30 decisions stay unchanged.

remaining_release_conditions: Decide whether the two-reader selective-use mechanism warrants a bounded science budget relative to the training-side north star. It is not automatically the next main study.

Verify genuinely fresh source availability, freeze source/protocol identities and all numerical settings, and support the proposed sample size with an explicit power calculation. No outcome-dependent expansion.

Qualify exact native source/stop/forced-closure handling on ordinary as well as calculation prefixes, feature causality, distribution normalization and the actual disabled path. CPU fixture mathematics cannot certify actual models.

Resolve a finite CPU/accelerator/storage budget and review the whole question before any actual model, feature-extraction or experiment-head run. CPU source preparation and guarded implementation are active; actual execution is held.
scope_limits: B0 remains frozen, so this cannot demonstrate improved direct B0 weights, internalization or general pretraining.
A gate computed after a calculation does not save its generation cost.
Existing supervised writer competence and the extra prediction path are real prerequisites/costs.
Learned mixing is prior work; no novelty claim from adding a head.
The raw-regression source review found the intended implementation,not a causal explanation. Another full CPT study still needs a credible uniform-NTP control.
Teacher-forced full-span likelihood does not establish complete-answer accuracy; ordinary FineMath suffix retention is not broad-language retention.
The deliberately enriched calculation cohort and a tolerated ordinary cost cannot establish a gain under the natural corpus mixture.

sources.role: Prior learned mixing and zero-contribution instability; not proof this draft will work.

assessment.recommendation: Retain as a bounded selective-reading hypothesis; resolve source/native/power/cost feasibility. No actual released-model features or experiment head exist. Do not promote to a training campaign or pretraining result.
assessment.why_it_is_different: The previous writer is not being asked to overcome an already degraded raw model. The actual unchanged B0 remains a separate predictor, and a supervised causal head rather than a sibling-centered reward learns when to use the fixed assisted path.
assessment.why_it_might_fail: The gate may not distinguish useful from harmful predictions prospectively, the assisted reader may contain little complementary full-span information, or apparent gain may be ordinary ensembling. The new active path can still regress.
assessment.north_star_boundary: Even a pass would be a fixed-backbone selective-inference result. Improving pretrained weights needs a separate intervention and a truly uniform-NTP control; internalization needs an explicit transfer study.
assessment.saved_score_decision: Retain mechanism candidate. Current owner scope includes bounded CPU data/power/runtime/cost feasibility. No released-model feature call or experiment-head fit is authorized by the saved-score bound.

saved_greedy_opportunity.decision: The unrestricted fixed pair has complementary token probabilities; absence of oracle opportunity is not a reason to reject it. This does not release feature/model calls or head fitting, establish causal recoverability, measure ordinary retention or justify a training campaign.

implementation_status.no_claim: These tests neither execute released B0/T weights nor qualify actual-model feature extraction, latency, generalization or head efficacy.
implementation_status.native_numerical_contract: Freeze before model calls: each original native greedy action must have independent CPU masked-logit regret<=.001 and CPU behavior-logp error<=.001. Report exact matches and numerical near ties separately; do not demand bitwise argmax equality where permitted FP32 kernels are numerically tied. Native sampler policy unchanged. No post-outcome tolerance change.

secondary_interventions.selection: Before model calls, choose first64 item IDs under SHA256(causal-reader-secondary:+item_id) in each of four fixed source-index stripes. Sources all from calculation DEV; do not select examples by notes or outcomes.
secondary_interventions.metadata: Hold each source original generated action-count/cap metadata across content interventions. Hidden states/entropies/predictive scores use the actually altered context. Explicit counterfactual diagnostic, not deployed-note generation.
secondary_interventions.primary_effect: Supporting only; no change to8 primary/guard requirements or power plan. Include1024 reader contexts in the same hard8-chip-hour budget.
